steps.title: The heading changed
steps.text: `dist/index.html` says `Loading greeting`. When the page ran `main.js`, compiled from `src/main.ts`, it replaced that text with **Hello from TypeScript modules via Gulp**. The page has one `<script type="module">` tag, for `main.js`.
steps.textZh: `dist/index.html` 里写的是「正在加载问候」。页面运行由 `src/main.ts` 编译出的 `main.js` 时，把这段文字换成了**经 Gulp 构建的 TypeScript 模块向你问好**。页面上只有一个 `<script type="module">` 标签，引用的是 `main.js`。

watch.label: Heading
watch.expect: Hello from TypeScript modules via Gulp

watch.label: Page scripts (not counting the guide)
watch.labelZh: 页面脚本（不含说明面板）

steps.title: The browser followed the import
steps.titleZh: 浏览器自己顺着 import 走
steps.text: There is no bundler. `main.js` starts with `import { sayHello } from './greet.js'`, and no `<script>` tag names `greet.js`, yet `sayHello` ran: the browser fetched `greet.js` by itself. That is why `src/main.ts` imports `./greet.js`, the name of the compiled file.
steps.textZh: 这里没有打包器。`main.js` 开头是 `import { sayHello } from './greet.js'`，没有任何 `<script>` 标签引用 `greet.js`，`sayHello` 却运行了：是浏览器自己去获取了 `greet.js`。所以 `src/main.ts` 导入的是 `./greet.js`，也就是编译后的文件名。

watch.label: <script> tags that name greet.js
watch.labelZh: 引用 greet.js 的 <script> 标签

watch.label: JavaScript files the browser downloaded
watch.labelZh: 浏览器下载的 JavaScript 文件

steps.title: What tsc wrote
steps.text: The TypeScript compiler, `tsc`, checked the types, then wrote one JavaScript file for each TypeScript file. It deleted the type annotation `: string` and kept the `import` as it was. This step fetches `src/greet.ts` and the compiled files and prints their first lines.
steps.textZh: TypeScript 编译器 `tsc` 先检查类型，再为每个 TypeScript 文件各写出一个 JavaScript 文件。它删掉了类型标注 `: string`，`import` 则原样保留。这一步会获取 `src/greet.ts` 和编译后的文件，打印它们的第一行。

action.run:
Promise.all(['../src/greet.ts', 'greet.js', 'main.js'].map((f) => fetch(f).then((r) => r.text()))).then(([ts, js, main]) => { console.log('src/greet.ts:', ts.split('
')[0]); console.log('dist/greet.js:', js.split('
')[0]); console.log('dist/main.js:', main.split('
')[0]); })

steps.title: Gulp runs the steps in order
steps.titleZh: Gulp 按顺序执行这些步骤
steps.text: `gulpfile.js` exports three functions, `clean`, `compile` and `html`, and a default task that runs them one after another with `series`. Each function tells Gulp it has finished through what it returns. If `tsc` finds a type error, it exits with an error code, and `series` does not run `html`.
steps.textZh: `gulpfile.js` 导出了三个函数 `clean`、`compile` 和 `html`，以及一个用 `series` 依次运行它们的默认任务。每个函数通过返回值告诉 Gulp 自己已经完成。如果 `tsc` 发现类型错误，它会以错误码退出，`series` 也就不会再运行 `html`。
